entries.why: Verified 2026-08-02: tools/brain.py is 8,700+ lines declaring 186 top-level symbols against a repo median of 11 — an order of magnitude past every other module. Real, and the kernel's own substrate found it. Not a defect to fix reflexively (a single-file CLI is a defensible shape for a tool meant to be copied into a clone), but it is the honest reason changes to it are hard to review, and it belongs on the record rather than being re-discovered each session.
